profile.headline: Lead Software Developer
profile.summary:
Full-stack software developer; 15+ years of experience including UI, backend, databases, containerization, ci/cd, and related technologies.

Technical leader; product level architecture, team mentoring, and classroom style training.

Software delivery and personnel management experience; employing lean/agile principles and scrum practices; teams varying from three to twenty members.

Co-founder and sole developer of SepiaTown; a PC Mag Top 100 website of 2010.

Committed to understanding client needs, crafting clean code, applying developer driven test automation, employing continuous delivery practices, and learning through study and feedback.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
SepiaTown is a visual history initiative based on a map-centric web application that enables a global community of users to search, view, and contribute to a library of geo-located historical photographs.  SepiaTown has garnered attention from media outlets, including The New York Magazine, Real Simple magazine, and The San Francisco Chronicle, as well as institutions, including The New York Public Library, the Powerhouse Museum of Sydney Australia, and The San Francisco Public Library.  SepiaTown was recognized by PC Mag as one of the Top 100 websites of 2010.

As co-founder and technical lead I am responsible for all software architecture and implementation; client-side, server-side, and database.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Served in a balanced role of Feature Lead, Chapter Lead, and Senior Developer for the purpose of enhancing the utility, scalability, security, and geographic scope of an enterprise web application.  Contributed product level technical direction, led feature team efforts, mentored, and merged code nearly everyday.

My contributions directly improved user experience and platform security as well as fulfilled integrations with other Frontline solutions via utilization of Java, Spring libraries, JavaScript, SQL, OAuth2/OIDC, microservices, message queues, test automation, architecture decisions, and work with peers both at a product team level and throughout the organization.

Grateful for the opportunity to have developed solutions that serve the needs of special educators and administrators.

positions.title: Principal Architect, Recruiting Technologies
positions.description:
•	Designed and led transformation of legacy product toward modern architecture
•	From Servlet/JSP monolith to Angular ‘micro-apps’ w/ Java/Spring microservices
•	Implemented git-flow model release process using Bitbucket, Jenkins, and Artifactory
•	Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins scripting to support development team efforts
•	Prepared and presented trainings on writing automated tests and JavaScript fundamentals

positions.title: Manager, Software Development
positions.description:
•	Managed team of ~15; developers, architects, and a business analyst
•	Led team during a period of significant client growth
•	Simultaneously managed aggressive efforts to scale and add new features to a legacy product

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Contributed to development of candidate facing job board application
•	Primarily mobile UI w/ JavaScript frontend and Java backend
•	Introduced receptive peers to TDD and related design concepts
•	Set up a CI server and integrated test runs to validate code commits

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer and Technical Lead
positions.description: Lead engineer and manager of development team.  Responsible for planning, design, testing, timeliness, and ultimately the quality of team deliverables.  Mentored team members while respecting their position and opinions as professionals.  Interfaced with other team leads throughout globally dispersed engineering dept.  Projects focused on internal components of content production platform.  Utilized scrum and agile management concepts for organizing work both day-to-day and over sprints.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to planning, design, and development as part of scrum based team creating a proprietary workflow management system.  Utilized TDD, simple design, and continuous integration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed design and development on various projects across globally dispersed engineering dept; including a web based resource library application, an automated testing framework, and a customer request/feedback application.

positions.title: Specifications Architect
positions.description:
Proposed, designed, and built a web application for the purpose of post acquisition quality control system integration.  Maintained ownership after moving to engineering dept.

Additionally, developed specifications and data quality requirements.  Provided specifications support for development of quality systems software.

positions.title: Consultant/Contractor
positions.description:
Work included:
•	Developed public facing meeting room booking calendar for local library
•	Developed software for compiling and analyzing thousands of art auction data points
•	Implemented software solutions for local college Math/Social Sciences Dept
•	Designed proprietary fantasy sports application
•	Developed e-commerce application for family business dedicated to natural children’s toys

positions.title: Technical Coordinator
positions.description:
- Data content subject matter expert for North American operations
- Authored work instructions for North American operations
- Led informational meetings and training sessions on a regular basis

positions.title: Regional Coordinator
positions.description:
- Technical leadership and issue resolution for production performed by 40+ employees
- Authorized one third of US quarterly editing production
- Organized & led quarterly production meetings for interdepartmental audiences of 50+

positions.title: Team Leader
positions.description:
- Supervisor of 10+ employees; performance/personnel management
- Technical leadership and issue resolution for team
- Authored ISO standard project documentation
